# DMSLib upstream

- Repository: https://github.com/Gideon-Taylor/DMSLib
- Pinned commit: `8120a53e172972a156a5e51f23859808967d57d8`
- License: MIT (see `DMSLib/LICENSE`)

The dependency is vendored so the solution builds without a network connection. To update it, replace `vendor/DMSLib` with a checkout of the desired upstream commit, update the pinned commit above, and rebuild the sample DAT test.
